title: Adam Silver Reveals Failed Behind-the-Scenes Effort With Michael Jordan to Resolve Long-Running Knicks Rift - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
Adam Silver (Image Credits: Imagn) After sweeping the Cleveland Cavaliers , the New York Knicks have reached the NBA Finals for the first time since 1999. Jalen Brunson’s team stepped onto the court on Wednesday for Game 1 of the Finals against the San Antonio Spurs. However, Knicks owner James Dolan also became a talking point after NBA commissioner Adam Silver revisited a long-standing controversy involving him.
Before Game 1, Silver addressed the widely known 2017 incident involving Knicks owner James Dolan and former player Charles Oakley. The commissioner revealed that both he and Michael Jordan had attempted to mediate peace between the two sides, but their efforts ultimately failed.
“I tried, Michael Jordan tried, to broker peace between Charles Oakley & Jim Dolan. Our efforts were unsuccessful. I think it’s unfortunate for the NBA…but it’s currently in litigation. I tried my best; I don’t really see anything else I can do at the moment ,” Silver said.
Dolan has controlled the franchise since 1999, while Oakley has repeatedly criticized his leadership. The tension escalated dramatically in 2017 during a nationally televised Knicks game.
Oakley was seated near Dolan in the arena when MSG security approached him shortly after he took his seat, instructing him to leave the venue. The Knicks organization later claimed that Oakley had been shouting abusive remarks toward Dolan from his seat.
Oakley refused to leave quietly. The situation escalated into a brawl with security staff, eventually leading to his arrest on a misdemeanor assault charge after he allegedly pushed security personnel. The Knicks owner later intensified the controversy by claiming that Oakley had issues with alcohol.
Nearly a decade later, the bad blood remains completely unresolved. Still, Oakley remains barred from The Garden after the incident.
Adam Silver Lauds Victor Wembanyama Before Game 1 The NBA commissioner recently discussed the growing trend of tanking in the league . Before Game 1, Silver also took time to highlight Spurs star big man Victor Wembanyama. Silver praised his rapid rise and unique presence in the league.
“ He’s just a huge personality, putting aside his size. Players come along every once in a while that in addition to having this incredible skill, love the promotional side of it, and want to play that role for the league ,” he said.
Victor Wembanyama (Image Credits: Imagn) Since entering the league from France, Wembanyama has taken the NBA by storm. His rise has also helped accelerate the visibility of international players across the league. The league no longer appears to be dominated solely by American stars; instead, a diverse pool of global talent is increasingly shaping it.
